I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was Southgate.

I got this from the incident channel itself, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4 at Southgate dispatch. Later that day she wrote that Southgate had cleared the backlog, and she closed the incident.

The channel doesn't give a street address or any more detail about the site, so if he needs that, I can't confirm it from what he has access to.
